title: AI Settings & Usage
notes: Not a list/table feature — settings + usage dashboard, so listPage/filterBar/infiniteScroll/hoverActions/detailDrawer/relationCombobox/urlPrefill/phoneInput/addressAutocomplete/currencyInput/datePicker/sendMessageDialog/themedExport are N/A by design. Rebuilt both pages on PageHeader/SectionCard/Stat/Tag with ds-* tokens, gated settings/ai behind useFeatureGate('ai_assistant') with a proper disabled/upgrade state (never an error), fixed ai-usage page to call the real aiApi.settings.getUsage() endpoint instead of a nonexistent /ai/usage, and added an AI tab to /settings linking to /settings/ai and /settings/ai-usage since neither was reachable before.
showcaseScript: Toggle individual AI features on and off
Show the active provider and model
Open AI Usage and show consumption against the daily cap
